author: Kushal
problem: piers lists the pier each of a ferry's sailings left from today, in departure order. Return how many sailings left from the same pier as the sailing before them.
bug_description: The loop starts at 0 instead of 1, so the first sailing is compared with piers[-1] (the day's last sailing) and counts as a repeat when the two piers match.

comments.accurate: Counts sailings that left from the same pier as the previous sailing
comments.wrong_behavior: Counts sailings whose pier matches the one before, treating the day's timetable as a repeating cycle
comments.wrong_location: Loop range verified; the pier comparison may treat 'a' and 'A' as different piers
